title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
statement_short: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k-th largest element in the array. Note that it is the k-th largest element in sorted order, not the k-th distinct element.
hint: Array size up to 10^5 permits maintaining a min-heap of size k to track largest elements in O(n log k) time.
why_not: Right: Heap / Priority Queue maintains a min-heap of size k to extract the k-th largest element in O(n log k) time and O(k) space. Not Sorting: Sorting the whole array takes O(n log n) time and extra space. Not Two Pointers: Two pointers require sorted inputs to shrink boundaries rather than tracking k top elements. Not Binary Search: Binary search on answer range takes O(n log(max-min)) time, which is more complex than maintaining a min-heap.
complexity: O(n log k) time, O(k) space
